slots.title: XRP Ledger developers tighten the rules for who can hold 'restricted' tokens
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A set of fixes would tighten who can hold permissioned tokens on the network. The XRP Ledger Foundation says no users were affected.

slots.title: Binance hack bites India's largest crypto exchange as it curbs futures trading
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: CoinDCX has restricted new futures positions after Binance’s security incident disrupted a key liquidity provider. Deposits, withdrawals and customer funds remain unaffected, the exchange said.

slots.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.

slots.title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn ‘tens of billions of dollars’
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The success of blockbuster hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity is only part of the story, Amazon's CEO says.

slots.title: Binance hacker splits $1.4 billion of bitcoin into 19 wallets that no one can freeze
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: All 18,270 coins sit in 19 wallets, 17 of them holding exactly 1,000 BTC each, and none has moved since Thursday night, a CoinDesk trace of the blockchain shows.

slots.title: $6 billion Binance hack sends bitcoin, ether tumbling; Standard Chartered expects more pain
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid after a suspected $6.3 billion Binance security breach and a Polymarket exploit. Standard Chartered says crypto prices may remain under pressure before finding a base.
